_comment: TEACHES NOTHING (#390). Teardown yields FUNCTION now, not knowledge; the market is the only source of tier knowledge. The pools below are unchanged - a teardown is never a total loss once you already have the part.
The carcass of a small cell: a steel can, the guts, a little plastic. Three draws,
because a battery is a small object and a pile of scrap out of one would read as
NO BATTERY IN THIS POOL, and none at the top level either. A dead cell is not a live
one, which is the whole point of the chain: the live Battery is manufactured, never
salvaged. This find is materials and nothing else.
